overlay: Recursively copy GUI files, including Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs, over that checkout before building GUI/Custom_UEVR_Injector.csproj.
steamPathBinding: --target-path selects only the exact shipping executable and revalidates its process creation identity on the opened handle. EXE Comments capability: WUWA_INJECTOR_TARGET_PATH_V1. No live Steam acceptance claimed.
graphicsChange: Profiles containing wuwa-graphics-policy.json preserve saved graphics files on injector startup. Explicit graphics slider changes patch only the selected key; absent overrides display Game. Marker-free legacy behavior is unchanged.
markerFailurePolicy: Presence of the marker is sufficient to suppress automatic defaults, including malformed or future receipts. The launcher owns receipt validation; a read error must not restore synthetic graphics overrides.
